description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance payable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper growing and manufacturing trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces special allowance payments for workers in the cocoa, cardamom and pepper growing/manufacturing trade based on the Cost of Living Index. This falls under public sector services and administration, specifically addressing service conditions and benefits for workers, which aligns with Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, legal regulations, commercial registrations, elections, or judicial appointments.
